svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the film to the same outline as the EVA base, with the same

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 11 mm motor hole and lead notch. Polyimide, so it takes solder.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay the film on the insole layout picture and mark the traces,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pads and sensor centres through it with a fine pen.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 6 mm copper tape into 1.5 mm strips with a steel rule and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: new blade. Lay each trace in one length, folding the tape at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corners rather than cutting it; burnish it flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Eight tail pads 2 x 5 mm, 4 mm apart, 10 to 15 mm from the heel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two tab pads at the end of each sensor tail, 2.54 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One crossover, beside the outer midfoot sensor: lay the outer

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front-foot trace, cover it with an 8 x 8 mm polyimide patch,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then lay the midfoot supply branch over the patch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a meter shows no connection between any two pads.
